mods.name: Info in Slot
mods.description: Displays Timer Auction/Order Price & Order Count for DonutSMP (Configurable)

releases.notes:
- Display Outlines (Background Alternative)
- Fixed Inventory and hotbar Display
Rainyday.gg Support
- Cloud Coins Display
- Special Items Display
- Scale Level Display
- Scale Letter Abbreviation Display

mods.name: Info in Slot
mods.description: Displays tooltip stats inside item slots. Made for Economy servers like DonutSMP

releases.notes:
added more display and detect tooltip types such as
 Buy/Sell, Shards, Coins, Rubies, Gems, Keys and Chance
 added new position type
 aside from just changing Vertical position, Top Middle Bottom
 now you can change Horizontal Position, Left Middle Right
 giving you 9 position options total instead of 3
 Added new size XSmall which is the old Small, and redefined Large to be bigger
 old larger is now considered Medium,
default size is the same as before but now its called Small instead of Medium
Mod was tested for a Few servers to visually work but should work for most Economy Servers
Server List: DonutSMP, Lifesteal.net, FyreSMP, Vplus (crates)
added Website linking to my Youtube Channel
added source linking to the Github page
